provenance.note: Tiruppur district's rivers, groundwater and industry (scope tiruppur-rivers; the district's own scope id is tn-tiruppur). The district boundary is the frame and TN WRD's sub-basins, clipped to it, are the catchments (shedId). The industry register holds only units TNGIS matched to a land parcel, so every count is a lower bound; sector comes from the reviewed TNPCB type-code lookup pipeline-inputs/basins/tn-tnpcb-type-sectors.json.

properties.name: Tiruppur CEPI core zone, on the banks of the Noyyal
properties.whatThisIs: A polygon through the 8 boundary reference points the plan prints. It encloses 11.9 sq km; the plan gives 12 sq km, matching the plan's figure.
properties.latestScore: 25.214 on TNPCB's post-monsoon 2025 evaluation (TNPCB score sheet, signed 23 June 2026)
properties.cepiScore: 72.39 (Air 33, Water 65, Land 64), CPCB's 2017-18 assessment as the plan prints it: a Critically Polluted Area (plan, p.10)
properties.earlierScore: 68.38 in CPCB's 2009 assessment (Comprehensive Environmental Assessment of Industrial Clusters, p.27)
properties.unitsInThePlan: 149 red and 6 orange category industries in the core zone, among them 7 CETPs and their 81 member units (plan, p.9)
properties.source: TNPCB, Evaluation of CEPI score and action plan for CEPI area of Tiruppur, January 2020 (TNPCB and CPCB websites)
